provenance: Read off a live UE 5.8 handshake on 2026-08-17. tests/unreal/live_editor_stages.py calls these names against a real editor, so a drifted name fails the acceptance run rather than rotting here.

discovery.note: Every toolset tool is reached through call_tool with toolset_name plus an unprefixed tool_name. describe_toolset returns the authoritative parameter schema; this catalogue is what to expect, not a substitute for reading it when a call is refused.

editor_toolset.toolsets.blueprint.Bluepr.purpose: Author and compile Blueprint assets in the open editor.

create.purpose: Create a Blueprint asset of a given parent class.

parameters.asset_type: {"refPath": "<full class object path>"} — never a bare class name

create.returns: An object carrying refPath for the created asset.
known_errors: Refuses once per missing argument, naming only the next missing one.
A bare class name such as Actor is rejected; pass /Script/CoreUObject.Class'/Script/Engine.Actor'.

compile_blueprint.purpose: Compile a Blueprint and report whether it succeeded.

parameters.blueprint: The object returned by create, or {"refPath": "..."}
parameters.warnings_as_errors: Boolean; must be supplied even though the schema marks it optional

compile_blueprint.returns: Null on success, which is not a failure.
known_errors: Returns null when it succeeds; read a follow-up query rather than the absence of an error.

editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools.purpose: Inspect and persist assets in the open editor.

exists.purpose: Whether an asset path resolves in the content tree.

save_assets.returns: Boolean true when every path saved.
known_errors: An unsaved Blueprint reads as existing but does not survive an editor restart; save before claiming the work landed.

EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.purpose: Drive Play In Editor and capture viewport evidence.

StartPIE.purpose: Begin a Play In Editor session.
known_errors: Starting while PIE already runs is an error; check IsPIERunning first.
PIE does not report running immediately; poll IsPIERunning rather than assuming.

StopPIE.purpose: End the current Play In Editor session.
known_errors: Always stop PIE before releasing the lane; a left-running session holds the editor.

IsPIERunning.purpose: Whether a PIE session is currently running.

GetVisibleActors.purpose: Read actor state from the running world.
GetVisibleActors.returns: Array of actor records; empty means nothing readable, which is a failure for evidence purposes.
known_errors: Returns an empty array outside a running PIE session rather than erroring.

CaptureViewport.purpose: Capture a viewport image as visual evidence.
CaptureViewport.returns: Content parts including an image part carrying PNG data.
known_errors: Refuses once per missing argument until every declared field is passed.
A result with no image part is a failed capture even when no error was raised.
